message: s3:ListAccessGrantsInstances is a permission-only action (empty resource_types in SAR). Boundary scopes it to a specific resource ARN but IAM ignores resource restrictions for permission-only actions — the scoping is a no-op. The role can list Access Grants instances regardless of account.

iam:PassRole restricted by iam:PassedToService but does not verify the role carries the managed-by tag. Pre-existing partner-managed/* roles created outside this session could be passed to access-grants.s3.amazonaws.com. Adding iam:ResourceTag/managed-by condition ensures only template-created roles are passable.
